third_party_evaluations.summary: IBM Cloud security: hybrid connectivity, Kubernetes/VMware hardening, IAM, and compliance config.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded IAM, hybrid connectivity and workload-hardening coverage supports professional cloud-control decisions; the two-year profile and IBM-specific scope limit claims of senior cross-cloud architecture.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded hybrid, IAM and hardening coverage supports associate implementation knowledge on IBM Cloud with a two-year profile. The professional hint is noted, but no senior-scope or practical-assessment factor establishes independent professional delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hybrid, Kubernetes, IAM and compliance configuration scope is modern and operationally relevant. Its two-year profile and lack of an explicit practical exam support associate platform knowledge rather than the professional source hint.
